description: This file implements a Gemini-specific Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) ingestion process, handling file storage and embedding through Gemini's File Search API. It manages creating file search stores, resumable uploads of files, and skips internal embedding as Gemini performs embedding during file upload. It extends a base ingestion class and uses asynchronous HTTP requests for Gemini API interactions.
